name: VAE - Shadow Matching!
author: anonymous-vae
description:
Instructions:
* Move the cubes by the cursor
* Use arrow keys to rotate the object
* Press "S" to snap the rotation
* Press key "D" to enter decoder mode and cast a shadow
* Press key "E" to enter encoder mode and move cubes
* Drag the navy blue cube will move the whole thing

Notes:
* Use Safari if Chrome doesn't work
* You can't move cubes around in decoder mode, press "E" to enter encoder mode and then move the cube.
